$comment: The one place the Low-Latency Audio installer version is set. build-all.ps1 reads it and
stamps it into the installer, the bundle, the Driver Selector and the setup custom actions.
The driver, the ASIO driver and the ASIO control panel keep their own version resources.
The version text is <major>.<minor>.<patch>-<channel>.<channelNumber>, for example
build: the 4th field of the numeric version only. -BuildNumber <n> overrides it without
changing this file; -BumpBuildNumber adds one and saves it.
IMPORTANT: Windows Installer compares only the first THREE fields of a version. Bump 'patch'
for every release that has to upgrade one customers already have.
